calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark, compare the latest 10-trading-day cumulative return with the preceding 20-trading-day cumulative return and scale the acceleration by trailing 20-day daily-return volatility. The complete signal is lagged one trading day to avoid look-ahead. Rank/signal is evaluated against 10-day forward return.

validation.regime_notes: The 10-day horizon materially outperformed 1-day and 5-day horizons in this run. Cross-section was the intended 15-instrument universe, with at least 8 valid instruments per IC date and approximately 14 on average. Small-universe uncertainty and the low aggregate matrix coverage require conservative sizing and periodic revalidation.

notes: Admission uses same-horizon 10-day paper Spearman IC and ICIR. Library correlation is intentionally recorded as null pending deterministic post-Miner audit; null is not treated as zero.
